propositions: Project criteria activated by _project_criteria are evaluated even during probe mode, causing extra billable LLM calls that should be suppressed by the probe allowlist
The probe allowlist (E4, G1G2) is threaded to the workflow assemble step but does not reach the batch step where project criteria are routed
Thread probe_criteria from gate inputs through BatchRunRequest.with_inputs to the batch step and filter project criteria to only those in the allowlist
The probe allowlist filtering in _project_criteria mirrors workflow_ops filtering semantics, suppressing project criteria not in the allowlist while remaining correct if the allowlist grows
Two monkeypatch stubs of _project_criteria in test files must accept a third probe parameter to avoid TypeError when the call site is updated
